hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic swap fees with surge pricing, a truncated geometric oracle, and full-range liquidity reinvestment of collected fees. On every swap, the hook charges a protocol fee plus a hardcoded 0.10% hidden surcharge (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) that is silently minted to the liquidity manager, with an always-true condition ensuring the surcharge is applied on exactOut swaps regardless of configured protocol fee settings.
